title: A Bronze Age
description: Based in Vancouver, A Bronze Age is a contemporary clothing and accessories label founded in 2016 that is redefining timeless silhouettes.

title: Adae
description: Established in November of 2020, the brand was founded by three Muslim, North African/Caribbean sisters who believe in providing high quality, ethical and luxury jewelry at accessible prices. All of their pieces are named after friends and family that have supported them through all the ups and downs of their endeavours.

title: ADAE Jewelry
description: Toronto's ADAE Jewelry was established in November of 2020. The brand was founded by three Muslim, North African/Caribbean sisters who believe in providing high quality, ethical and luxury jewelry at accessible prices. All of their pieces are named after friends and family that have supported them through all the ups and downs of their endeavours!

title: Ade
description:
Short for Adétola, designer Andrea Kpenou's Yoruba first name, Adé is an ode to her Beninese origins and a celebration of diversity.
Ade earrings were made for those who were marked by a lack of positive representation in their youth. By wearing Ade earrings, Andrea would like you to remain visible, beautiful, and strong. Inspired by her African roots, visual arts and ceramics, Andrea aims to explore shapes, colors, and materials to tend towards an original object. To celebrate what makes us unique.

title: AJ Morgan
description: Based in Los Angeles, AJ Morgan are known for their seriously hip frames at seriously hip prices! These funky styles will show off your fashion flair without breaking the bank.

title: Alexandre Bergeron
description: Alexandre Bergeron is a jewelry maker born in Charlevoix, Quebec who is now based in Montreal. He believes that jewelry is a wearable art form, a personal coat of arms and an imperfect, astonishing form of beauty.

title: Amanda Moss
description: Toronto-based Amanda Moss always chooses the most high-quality fabrics, making the most effortless and luxurious basics perfect for your capsule wardrobe. Feminine yet classic, her pieces are the made-in-Canada staples you'll wear for years to come!

title: Amara Blue
description: British Columbia's Amara Blue make pieces meant to be held onto, treasured and passed down. Made out of ethically sourced Sterling Silver and Gold Fill, all of their pieces are personally handcrafted.

title: Amery Sandford
description: Amery Sandford is an animator, illustrator, musician, and printmaker based in Montreal. Her newfound interest in illustration and music led her to do an internship at Hatch Show Print in Nashville, Tennessee in 2016, a printshop situated within the Country Music Hall of Fame. During her time at Hatch, Amery got to work with clients and design and print posters the old-fashioned way, using letterpress typefaces and photo plates. She learned a great deal about design basics in a very hands-on way and also enjoyed exploring the city's honky-tonk bars and making many new friends along the way.

title: Anne Dahl
description: Anne Dahl, an Ottawa-based jewelry and intermedia artist, works primarily with sterling silver to create stunning minimalist-yet-artistic earrings and necklaces.

title: Anushka
description: Anya Georgijevic is the designer and founder of Anushka Studio. Anya is a former style journalist, Anushka combines her background in architecture and fashion. The name "Anushka" pays homage to a childhood endearment from her mother, while the designs reflect a love for sculptural forms, intricate details and enduring style. Anushka is a contemporary resort wear line with a focus on the use of sustainable natural fabrics.

title: Apothecary
description: This collection of apothecary items features small batch skin and body care products that will help you look and feel great!

title: Arako
description: Arako was founded by Anaëlle Rako in 2018. Using European fabrics, Arako creates ultra-comfortable undergarments made locally in Montreal.

title: Archerade
description: Archerade's pieces are carved and cast by Sasha Oda in her west-end Toronto goldsmithing studio. From start to finish, everything is done in-house.

title: Artistorian
description: Cassandra Marsillo is a public historian, artist, and educator, based in Tiohtià:ke (Montreal), telling and listening to stories about immigration, identity, collective memory, food, and folklore, particularly in relation to the Italian-Canadian experience and traditions from my family's region, Molise. She is also interested in representations of girlhood in the context of 90s and y2k pop/post-feminism and girl power movements.

title: Ash & Posy
description: Ash & Posy is an Ottawa-based, handcrafted skincare line. Before becoming a skincare formulator, founder Andrea worked as a hairstylist and saw a need for a more inclusive image of beauty that prioritizes skin health. Her line is thrilled to be a part of this natural and necessary evolution within the industry.

title: Atelier B
description: Atelier B's best friend duo Anne-Marie and Catherine founded their brand in 2009 with a focus on minimalist and sustainable fashion that's designed and produced in Montreal. The pair highlight their key values of slow fashion design with their circular economy project which has made the brand the first in Canada to have zero-waste manufacturing.

title: Atelier Melrai
description: When you shop at Victoire you are supporting independent designers from across the country like Atelier Melrai. Inspired by the shapes of nature, Atelier Melrai is a slow-made jewelry brand by Melissa Rainone. The idea around the brand started with appreciating the healing power of the ocean. Each shell is hand-picked and each pearl is precisely chosen for its own individualization, creating pieces that manifest nature’s true resilience. Each piece is one-of-a-kind and handmade in its own vulnerability.

title: Atelier Nature Morte
description: Atelier Nature Morte is an artisanal design studio, which crafts paper flower arrangements and hand-printed wallpaper created by Sarah Kestenberg. Every design is crafted in their Montreal studio, and utilises traditional lino block printing techniques. Much care is put into sustainability and use the finest materials.

title: Baby, It's Cold Out Sale
description: Take 20-70% off cozy sweater knit styles while sizes last!

title: Bad Wrld
description: Bad Wrld is a luxury fashion brand specializing in one-off and limited edition robes and accessories for after swim, bath, spa, club or lounging. Bad means bath in Dutch, which designer Danica Olders first discovered as a child visiting family unable to find the bathroom. The line is a playful homage to her heritage and family. Everything is produced as ethically and slow as possible, utilizing recycled towels and 100% cotton terry cloth.

title: Bags & Wallets
description: Whether you prefer a small clutch or a mega tote, our selection of Canadian-made bags and wallets features purses and leather goods that will last for years to come.

title: Bang Bang Bijoux
description: Bang Bang Bijoux is a jewelry and accessory line created in a charming little studio in downtown Edmonton, Alberta. Each hand-crafted treasure is created with the intention of incorporating unusual and unexpected materials

title: Bare Knitwear
description: Bare Knitwear is a Canadian brand that ethically produces their loungewear in Ayacucho, Peru. They collaborate with small producers and artisan groups throughout Peru for the development of their signature alpaca, wool and pima cotton collections.

title: BARRE Perfume
description: BARRE is a collection of fine fragrances created by visual artist Bree Hyland. Each scent extends from the desire to create unique aromas for any season and changeable mood. Perfume is a way to create a personal aura, wearable art, a signature that can ignite lust, attraction, magic and mystery. What could be better?

title: Batik Boutik
description: Maya Amoah of Batik Boutik aims to showcase the incredible talent of artisans from Africa through fashion, accessories and decor. Batik Boutik is a socially responsible line that provides you with clothing and accessories inspired by the bold and vibrant designs that are unique to the eclectic culture of West Africa using ethical trading and sustainability practices to create each piece.

title: Beadwork
description: Our beadwork collection proudly showcases the incredible craftsmanship of Indigenous artists from diverse communities across the country. By supporting these artists, we celebrate and honour their heritage while bringing vibrant and authentic creations to a wider audience.

Vanessa (nick-named Mona in childhood by her mother), fosters a deep love for accessories. With experience working and designing in the garment industry, Vanessa decided to create a bag that not only spoke to her, but wouldn't sacrifice comfort and warmth in exchange for quality design and materials. All bags are designed and made by hand by Vanessa in Montreal with locally sourced materials!

description:

description: Looking to start a capsule wardrobe? These versatile and neutral slow fashion pieces are some of our all-time bestsellers that will have your back for years to come.

title: Carolyn Ferreira
description: Born in Canada, Carolyn Ferreira's main focuses are to promote ethical work, respect resources and use certified all natural materials. Her pieces are classic and designed to last for years to come!

title: Cartouche
description: Cartouche's jewelry is handmade by Audrey-Anne Frenette, a Gatineau-based artist whose goal is to make minimalist jewelry that showcases the beauty in simple materials by using textiles and resin.

title: Central Standard
description: Amy Bewcyk is the founder and creative behind Central Standard. Founded in 2019, the line is designed and handmade in the Cathedral area of Regina, Saskatchewan on Treaty 4 Territory. Bewcyk's practice is made up of consciously designed basics for everyday life, using natural fibres and ethically produced in Canada.

description: Charmed!

description:
Victoire Boutique curates a collection of Canadian designers making clothing that combines joyful style, sustainable and ethical manufacturing, with a goal of being the vintage of tomorrow.

title: Colour Happy!
description: A collection of bright colourful pieces that are sure to spark joy and get you excited for warm weather. Have fun mixing and matching these bright colours and pretty patterns from designers like Osei Duro, Eve Gravel, Bodybag by Jude, Jennifer Glasgow and more!

title: Comfy Cozy
description: Slow fashion can be comfortable! Stay cozy in our favourite nap dresses, sweatshirts and lounge pants.

title: Complexgeometries
description: Complexgeometries hopes to bridge the gap between comfort, luxury, and innovation. Marrying a thoughtful, fashion-forward approach to essential jersey tees, minimalist dresses, and staple footwear with a pared-down aesthetic and unexpected details, founder and designer Clayton Evans creates a full lifestyle-ready line of pieces for men and women who want to bring an effortlessly clean, contemporary edge to any look.

title: Connally Goods
description: When you shop at Victoire you are supporting independent designers from across the country like Connally McDougall, the founder of Connally Goods. Connally Goods make essential styles for everyBODY. You can find their zero-waste, size and gender inclusive styles from size S to 5X in store and online. Their goal is to provide clothing that not only looks good but feels good, knowing it was made with respect for people and the planet. Equally important, Connally Goods upholds ethical practices by providing living wages to everyone involved in bringing our designs to life. When you wear Connally Goods, you’re supporting fair labour, sustainable production, and timeless style that truly makes a difference.

title: Cottage Capsule
description: Packing for the cottage is its own joy!

title: Coutukitsch
description: Based in Calgary, CoutuKitsch jewelry is curated and handcrafted by a small team led by Dorian Kitsch and her partner Kofi Oteng. 'Coutu’ is a family name representing Dorian's Métis heritage and ‘Kitsch’ is her surname. The brand is beloved for their minimalist-yet-modern hoops, chains and hair accessories, all at an affordable price.

title: Dagg & Stacey
description: Toronto designers Dagg and Stacey create beautiful clothing made from natural fabrics and beautiful prints. Their pieces are classic, comfortable and timeless. In their collection, you'll find outfits perfect for work, special occasions and everyday life, all ethically made in Canada.

title: Daisyhead Vintage
description: Toronto's Daisyhead Vintage mixes the old with the new in modern and playful way. The brains behind the brand, Ainslie, even used to work at Victoire! Check out her curated line of vintage clothing on her website.

title: Daldanea Jewelry
description: Daldanea Jewelry is created by Molly Ocean Patterson, a Saskatchewan born Métis artisan/craftswoman. Recently, she moved back home with her wife and 'model in residence,' Sofía, to transition to quieter life of crafts, gardening and family making (cats included). Her designs are influenced by different life experiences along her travels and her interests in Folklore, Mythology and Pictorial Arts.

title: Danielle Wright
description: Danielle Wright creates items for not-so-serious people who love fun and well-made objects. Currently, she produces a line of silkscreen-printed leather goods all of which are made by hand in her small studio in Hamilton, Ontario.

title: DConstruct
description: Each DConstruct piece is designed and manufactured with eco-friendly materials  Lisa and Sean in Winnipeg, Manitoba. Their work is inspired by nature and minimalist design and is handmade from leading architectural materials - recycled content that would otherwise be waste from producers of sky lights, store fixtures and vending machine covers. Each piece contains a minimum of 40% pre-consumer recycled material.

title: Decade
description: Based out of Vancouver, British Columbia, Decade is run by four old-time friends who are passionate about well-made clothing and environmental sustainability. All of their denim is made using 100% cotton certified by the BCI (Better Cotton Initiative) and all of their production scraps are recycled into insulation for homes and cars.

title: Denim
description: Shop our selection of Canadian designed and ethically manufactured denim, including such designers as Decade Studio from Vancouver, focusing on 100% cotton denim, and Naked & Famous from Toronto, made with Japanese style denim.

title: Devlyn Van Loon
description: Devlyn Van Loon is a small-batch, slow fashion house with a focus on sustainable fabrics and ease of movement with every piece. Each piece is thoughtfully made in Toronto, Canada.

title: Dinner Party
description: Whether you're the host or the guest of honour, here are our top picks to stun at a dinner party!

title: DorsaLi
description:
Designer Dorsa Babaei was born in Iran, cultivated in India and studied Haute Couture at an esteemed French fashion school in Dubai UAE. From its early origins in Dubai, dorsaLi has been incubating quietly for seven years, and now she has her roots set in Montreal, CA. 

Each and every pattern is draped by the art of Moulage on the dress-form, processed by samples in canvas, and with final production done in house. DorsaLi aims to create thought-inspiring pieces to perfection, worthy of being reproduced in small batches only, from the greatest quality ­fabrics.

title: Dova Pryce Jewelry
description: When you shop at Victoire you are supporting small independent designers from across the country like Anna Garault the designer and founder of Dova Pryce Jewelry. Anna designs and hand crafts timeless and unique genderless jewelry out of her Montreal studio. Every piece is hand made with care and polished to perfection.

title: Dresses
description:
Victoire Boutique curates a collection of Canadian designers making dresses that combines joyful style, sustainable and ethical manufacturing, with a goal of being the vintage of tomorrow. Shop every day staples for office work or casual wear, to party dresses for your next cocktail party, wedding or special occasion.

For over fifteen years, the majority of women's clothing and accessories we showcase in our shop are proudly and ethically made in Canada. We are slow fashion at our core.

We don’t believe in any fashion rules other than joyously dressing for yourself.

title: EACH
description: EACH is an NYC-based brand that makes jewelry and accessories that are ethical, sustainable and high-quality.

title: Earrings
description: Victoire's jewelry is made by independent Canadian and American designers dedicated to creativity and the finest craftsmanship using ethical business practices. We are thrilled by our collection of fun, eclectic and classic earrings.

title: Earth and Elle
description: Earth and Elle's Rachelle designs all of the line's garments from her home-based atelier. She's based a few hours north of Vancouver BC, nestled in a rural landscape and loves to grow gardens abundant with herbs, flowers, veggies, and dye plants from spring to fall while conjuring up new designs for Earth and Elle during the winter.

title: Edme
description: EDMÉ is a brand of unique beadwork creations reflecting meticulous craftsmanship and artistic flair created by Bingyuan Wang, an artist based in Montreal.

title: Elaine Ho
description: Montreal's Elaine Ho creates solid 14K gold and oxidized sterling silver jewelry with a dark and playful sense of humour, often summed up as "cute but deadly". Elaine's jewelry is moody, industrial and edgy. Elaine Ho often utilizes darkened silver with an oxidized finish juxtaposed with playful shapes and humorous imagery that is both brutalist and endearing in quality.

title: Eleven Thirty
description: Eleven Thirty produces beautiful leather bags in their Toronto studio. They do not waste any part of the natural, genuine leather hides, therefore small variations may be visible and only add to the character and beauty of their unique pieces. These bags are made-to-order. We ask that you please allow up to two weeks for production.

title: Eleventh House Jewellery
description: Eleventh House Jewellery is designed and made by hand in Toronto by Morgan Dowler. She uses high quality sterling silver and 18k gold vermeil to craft her minimalist and classic line of necklaces and earrings.

title: Eliza Faulkner
description:
Eliza Faulkner is a Montreal-based designer known for her bold use of colour and textures, ultra-feminine dresses and playful, relaxed attitude towards dressing. We love her experimental and flattering silhouettes, which are offered in extended sizing up to size 20. She has been nominated twice by CAFA for Womenswear Designer of the Year.

description: FFORM is a design conscious brand whose mission is to inspire meaningful consumption. Designed in Toronto by its founder Melanie Wong and responsibly crafted in Peru where she grew up, FFORM collaborates with mills and cooperatives that are Fair Trade Certified or that comply with social and environmental standards as set out by the United Nations' Declaration of Human Rights. The collection is created with the luxurious, biodegradable and renewable alpaca yarn and Peruvian cotton.

title: Filorama
description: When you shop at Victoire you are supporting independent Canadian designers and artisans from across the country like Chanel the designer and maker behind Filorama. In an increasingly digital and artificial world, Chanel is devoted to creating embroidered works that can be touched and held. These pieces serve as a reminder of the simple beauty that surrounds us in everyday life.

title: Fine Jewelry
description: Our fine jewelry collection features pieces that are hand-crafted and high-quality. These pieces are made using metals like solid gold and sterling silver, as well as 14k and 18k gold fill. This collection also features beadwork with precious stones, which we consider to be fine jewelry based on its intricate craftsmanship and exclusive nature.

title: Foe & Dear
description: Katherine Schlattman founded Foe & Dear in a tiny apartment in Williamsburg, Brooklyn during the thick of summer in 2009. More than a decade later, each of Foe & Dear's pieces are made to both endure and delight in their studio in Vancouver, BC, with a  special emphasis on eco-friendly acetate hair accessories and jewelry.

title: Fofi
description: Sophie Ayotte, the creator behind Fofi is a designer-artisan and multidisciplinary artist based in Bromont, Quebec. Sophie has developed her practice with a focus on ceramics. She designs playful and sensitive utilitarian pieces with the aim of brightening up everyday life. Her approach highlights the intimacy between the material and the artisan's gesture, as well as between the object and the user. Born from sensitive know-how, each creation is created with the aim of celebrating slowness and inviting people to consume with heart and conscience.

title: Fortiv
description: Michelle Larsen created and founded Fortiv in 2018 out of a desire to re-imagine an alternative way to create clothing, one that is grounded in a holistic and resourceful approach to fashion. Fortiv's mission is to create a supportive and creative community that inspires us to rethink the way we create, consume, and connect to what we wear.

title: Frnge
description: Julie-Anne is the Vancouver-based maker behind FRNGE. Dakelh and Metis on her mother's side, Julie-Anne wasn't able to engage with the culture when she was growing up, as her mother was adopted into a non-Indigenous family. She first learned how to bead from her Indigenous school counsellor in Grade 3 and would spend countless lunch hours with her doing this. Most of her work is beaded using traditional and contemporary styles, and she uses it both to connect with her roots, as well as to try to bring something new to the world.

title: GanK
description: At Gank, we prioritise the local and slow fashion aspects of our clothing, in addition to the comfort and versatile style. Proudly made in Montreal.

The vision is to empower women and artisans in Iran, and expose their talent to the global market. Founded in Vancouver, BC in 2023.

title: Great Lakes Goods
description: Designer Rose Lazar founded Great Lake Goods on the premise that an object can have a vibe, and a vibe can change your life. Referencing the past via song lyrics, movie quotes and iconic symbols, there's a nostalgia to everything they make.  Working out of her Brooklyn studio, each print is hand printed and each wooden home décor piece is hand painted.

title: Hailey Jane
description: Ottawa's Hailey Loftus specializes in bringing you carefully sourced and lovingly handcraft pieces that are high quality gold-fill of sterling silver meant to be well loved and worn for years to come.

title: Hair Accessories
description: From hair combs, clips, barrettes, head-bands and scrunchies to straw hats, visors and bucket hats - we'll get your tresses dressed to impress!

title: Hannah Isolde
description: Hannah Isolde Goodman is a young designer who creates her small-scale women's wear collection out of her Montreal studio. She specializes in comfortable and whimsical silhouettes and emphasizes the use of deadstock fabrics in her pieces.

title: Harly Jae
description: Harly Jae is born out of designer Laïla Potvin's desire to pursue her love of fashion and design, but also to disrupt the rules of the industry. Her clothing line reflects her aesthetic as well as her ethical and environmental values, choosing fabrics that have a low environmental impact such as hemp, organic cotton, linen and deadstock fabrics. Everything is produced locally in Vancouver, BC, and made to stand the test of time, giving you quality pieces that will be treasured for years to come.

title: Hats, Mitts & Scarves
description: An ethically-made accessory is just the cherry on top of your gorgeous outfit!

title: Hawkly
description: Gillian Johnson is the designer behind the ethereal line Hawkly Jewelry. Gillian has settled between Toronto and a yurt in rural Ontario, where each piece is handcrafted with an emphasis on lost wax casting, combined with other metalsmithing and beading techniques. Her jewelry is available in either sterling silver or bronze.

title: Heirloom Hats
description: Heirloom Hats was born out of Samantha-Tara Mainville's imaginative mind, with the goal to create hats and headpieces that will stand the test of time. Every Heirloom piece is imagined, created and developed by hand in her Montreal based studio.

title: Hello Darling Co.
description: Miriam is the designer and creator of Hello Darling Co. Based out of Winnipeg, Manitoba, every piece is conceptualized and created thoughtfully by hand to ensure a one-of-a kind accessory that will make the wearer feel confident being seen and standing out.

title: Hey Johanna
description: Hey Johanna is a small-batch clothing line focused on sustainable, craft-based clothing made using natural and recycled fibres.

title: High Noon Ceramics
description: Leah Lavergne the designer behind High Noon Ceramics is a self-taught ceramicist practicing since 2016. High Noon a Toronto based ceramics company. Using her dance background, creator Lavergne draws inspiration from movement; an essential element to High Noon’s aesthetic. Whether it’s morning, noon or night, our goal is to provide pieces that bring a sense of comfort and excitement to the everyday routine.

title: hijulez
description: Julie Newton is the founder and designer behind hijulez Clothing. Hijulez is a brand that focuses on well-made and ethically produced small batch clothing with a focus on natural textiles, dyes, and recycled materials from Vancouver, BC. Julie ensures that every person in the hijulez team, from branding, to sewing, to modelling, is paid a living wage and given an opportunity to express artistic freedom.

title: Hilary MacMillan
description: Hilary MacMillan is a fashion-forward brand based in Toronto. The eponymous brand was founded in 2013 and focused on using high-quality, cruelty-free materials in bold colours and exceptional textures. Their production is split between Canada and China. Hilary MacMillan only produces with manufacturers which are aligned with the brand's standards and who are transparent about their processes.

title: Holiday
description: These are some of our favourite pieces that are perfect for your holiday parties! You'll find the glitz, glam, lace, and even some cozy sweaters to get you through the season!

title: Hoops
description: Victoire's jewelry is made by independent Canadian designers dedicated to creativity and the finest craftsmanship using ethical business practices. We are thrilled by our collection of fun, eclectic and classic hoops.

title: House of Hudson
description: Made in Toronto, House of Hudson's Melissa Hudson tries to "find the secret to blobs and shapes."

title: Indigenous Icons
description: From beadwork to metalwork and fashion made to last, Indigenous artists have been at the top of the game for millennia. We stand behind Indigenous made, not indigenous-inspired. See our selection of wearable artworks rooted in tradition and sustainable values.

title: Iris
description: Shop our selection of ethical, Canadian made denim by Toronto based Iris Denim. From high waisted jeans with vintage-inspired cuts and washes, wide leg to classic skinny jeans, Toronto's Iris Denim are a BFF duo who design the best Canadian made jeans we've ever seen. Sadly, they've ended their line but happily Victoire is the last place to stock it! Once a size or style is sold out, it's gone forever, so don't sit on it for too long.

title: Isla Loves Rick
description: Ilsa Loves Rick's jewelry is made by hand in small batches in Bucks County, Pennsylvania, marrying minimalist design with downtown cool.

title: It's a Heat Wave!
description: A curated collection of our favourite items that are great for beating the heat in! Here you will find the best linens, flowy fits, cropped tanks, comfy shorts, and summer accessories all to help you beat the heat ;)

title: It's a Match!
description: Game... Set... Match!

title: Jacoba Jane
description: Founded in 2019, Jacoba Jane specializes in silk dresses, blouses and scrunchies in bright, bold colours that are difficult to find. All of their clothing is handcrafted based on artisanal systems of the past in their studio on the west coast of Canada.

title: Janet Welsh
description: Janet Welsh is an Ottawa-based knitter who draws on a variety of influences in designing her colour work mittens.

title: Jen Klukas Design
description: Jen Klukas is a Vancouver-based tufting artist and designer, combining illustration with textile design. She began tufting to complement her digital illustration work and enjoys blending hand-punched and machine-assisted techniques. Her work is designed to infuse spaces with a touch of warmth, joy, and a sense of playful whimsy.

title: Jennifer Glasgow
description: Jennifer Glasgow is a design house based in Montreal with a focus on creating ecologically thoughtful womens clothing for multifaceted and discerning women. Their in-house team designs and produces their collections with the help of highly skilled seamstresses in Montreal, who are committed to creating an ethical work environment.

title: Jewelry
description: Victoire's jewelry is made by independent Canadian designers dedicated to creativity and the finest craftsmanship using ethical business practices. We are thrilled by our collection of fun, eclectic and classic pieces.

description: Victoire's jewelry is made by independent Canadian designers dedicated to creativity and the finest craftsmanship using ethical and sustainable business practices. We are thrilled by our collection of fun, eclectic and classic pieces.

title: Jewelry Under $50
description: Victoire's jewelry is made by independent Canadian designers dedicated to creativity and the finest craftsmanship using ethical business practices. We are thrilled by our collection of fun, eclectic and classic pieces.

title: Jumpsuits
description: Not into dresses but still want a piece with that special occasion feel? An ethically made jumpsuit is just the thing to wear!

title: Kaela Kay
description: Kaela Kay's Catherine resigned from her full-time corporate job in 2017 to focus on building her brand. With a focus on her Ghanaian roots, her clothing emphasizes the beauty in the prints and colors that come from and represent Africa through the Ankara textiles with designs that are feminine, classic and classy. In her words, "The future is bright, so why wear boring clothes?!"

title: Kara Yoo
description: Kara Yoo is designed and made in Canada. They create transitional pieces that fit with everyday lifestyles. They can be easily worn for special occasions, casual moments, the workplace, travels etc, and are made to be cherished for years to come. They are Asian and woman-owned and consist of a small, diverse team of 7 women.

title: Kate Austin Designs
description: Kate Austin Designs makes casual, comfortable and fun clothing and accessories. The fair-trade line is made in collaboration with traditional artisans in Toronto, Peru and India. The pieces are made to be one size and look easy and adorable on many different bodies. The line features Kate's bold and colourful block-printed designs, which are like art you can wear!

title: Katie's Favourites
description: Victoire co-owner Katie Frappier loves pieces that evoke a long past and adventures ahead. Definitely one to prioritize over-dressing in all scenarios while looking for a balance of good grace, humour and beauty. Here are some of her favourites in the shop.

title: Kiki Bridges
description:
Kiki Bridges offers ceramic pieces between art and function, lovingly built and painted by hand in Montreal. Objects that reference myth and culture, between the ancient and a not to distant past; of icons and idols, the sacred and profane. 

Take care of these objects and they will last an eternity.

title: KISS dressing
description:
Keep It Simple Silly, 

Fall dressing made effortlessly lovely with these gems

title: Kitaroo Art
description: Kitaroo Art's Sarah Byrne is a Canadian artist born and raised in the small town of Sault Ste. Marie in Northern Ontario. Sarah's work is a continued practice of exploration and experimentation, drawing inspiration from the natural world around her to create lush, vibrant, and colourful works of art based on places been and places dreamt.

title: Knits
description: When the cold weather comes, it's time to bundle up with a sustainable knit sweater made out of luxurious natural fibres like cotton and wool.

title: Korelli
description: When you shop at Victoire you are supporting independent Canadian designers from across the country like Silvia, the founder of Korelli Designs. Silvia is originally from Barcelona, where she completed a degree in Fashion Design before relocating to Canada. Silvia now lives in Montreal where At Korelli, they are committed to quality, durability, and craftsmanship. Korelli focuses on using quality natural fibers to ensure that each garment not only feels incredible but also stands the test of time. Each collection is created in collaboration with talented local artisans and supports the local economy.

title: KSLAM
description: Founded in 2016 by designer Casey Lamb in Vancouver, KSLAM is a unique fashion brand dedicated to reinvention & sustainability. Since its launch, KSLAM has focused on making clothing for individuals who are colorful, confident, and free. The quantities are small, ensuring minimal waste and reference both vintage & modern aesthetics.

title: L'amoureuse
description: L’amoureuse's founder Andréa Desforges-Caron is a jewelry maker in Montreal, Canada. With more than 10 years of experience in the fashion design area, L’amoureuse is the result of her love for the arts and her passion for jewelry. She makes all of her pieces by hand, one by one in her little studio based in the Mile-ex district. All production and materials are sourced locally in Montreal.

title: L'Aune
description: Since 2016, L'Aune's Karine Denault has studied jewelry and gemology at the Visual Arts Centre of Montreal, the Montreal School of Jewellery as well as the Montreal School of Gemology. With meticulousness and perfectionism, she continues her exploration of form and movement by creating wearable art for your everyday life.

title: La Manufacture Fait Main
description: Emmanuelle Doyon is the brains behind Montreal based La Manufacture Fait Main, who's main mission is to create beautiful handmade jewelry packed with care and love. Emmanuelle creates each piece out of her home studio between Montreal and the Magdalen Islands, where she runs a seasonal shop called Le Portique. The wild beauty of the Magdalen Islands and the natural maritime elements of her environment inspires much of her collections.

title: Le Bon Shoppe
description: Le Bon Shoppe is the brainchild of three women who were on the search for perfect socks to wear with any shoe, that are not just comfortable and chic but sustainable as well. Since then, they've expanded their line to include the most comfortable tees and loungewear. Their designs are simple yet well made and playful!

title: Leka
description: All of Leka's clothing is cut and sewn by hand in their shop and studio in Victoria, British Columbia. They take great care to source low-impact fabrics and use only natural fibres and organic cotton in their garments. They are also a women-helmed company, in addition to having an all-woman production team who are paid a living wage.

title: Lele de Baltzac
description: Lele de Baltzac is created by Kim Bettez, a former worker in the financial industry who traded it all in to follow her passion for fashion and design. Kim's designs are elegant, playful and effortlessly chic. Her love for her family is revealed in the name of her brand: Lele for her daughter Leonore and Baltzac for her son Balthazar.  Pieces from Lele de Baltzac are both designed and manufactured in Canada.

title: Leona
description: When you shop at Victoire Boutique, you're supporting independent designers like Leona's Megan; an Ojibwe artist based out of tiohtiá:ke/Montreal. Megan's handmade beadwork showcases playful, contemporary designs within a traditional art form.

title: Lepidoptere
description: Montreal-based Lépidoptère makes revisited wardrobe essentials (think your perfect work capsule) with original designs. The brand has a high level of attention to detail, ranging from their choice of fabrics to their masterful cuts. They use local production and eco-friendly materials to reduce their environmental impact.

title: Lidia Jewelry
description: Montreal's Lidia Jewelry has been making jewelry since her childhood. She later attended school to hone her craft before eventually launching her brand in 2011. All her handmade pieces are made to help women feel fabulous and invincible every day!

title: Lights Of All
description: Katia Hagen is the one-woman superstar behind the Toronto label Lights Of All, a vegan line committed to both style and sustainability.

title: Lilou Gems
description: Lilou Gems is a collection of mostly demi-fine jewelry, but also knitwear, with every piece being designed and handmade by Maude, a jewelry designer/maker from Montreal.

title: Lingerie
description: Our selection of Canadian-made lingerie features ready-to-wear and made-to-order pieces perfect for the bedroom and everyday.

title: Lisbeth
description: Based in Toronto, Lisbeth Jewelry evokes an air of modern simplicity. The designs are minimal, timeless and designed to be layered together or worn simply in their essence on their own. All of the brand's jewelry is made out of 14K gold fill or sterling silver, making Lisbeth a great choice for those with allergies or sensitivities.

title: Little Gold
description: Steph Shannon designs each piece of Little Gold Jewelry from her studio in Victoria. Drawing inspiration from art, symbolism and places both real and not, Shannon believes that each jewelry piece has a story, a history waiting to be made. Since 2013, her pieces have been thoughtfully made in Victoria and Jaipur to become your new everyday favourites.

title: Little Shiny Wolf
description: Little Shiny Wolf is the designer's name translated into English from Nisga'a. She is from the Nisga'a Nation on her mother's side, and African American mixed on her father's. She started dabbling in beading in 2017 in Toronto. She had always appreciated Indigenous beaded jewelry and Regalia, but gained an even greater appreciation for all the passion, love, time, and labour that goes into creating various pieces the more involved she became in the Indigenous community in Toronto. She continues her journey as a beading artist to present day, creating in Calgary now.

title: Long Weekend Sale on Sale
description: We're going out with a bang! Take an extra 20% off items in this collection with the code LASTHURRAH. Discount code ends Monday, Sept. 2nd at midnight.

title: Lovestruck
description: Lovestruck Prints is Geneviève Darling's screen printing and illustration project. Lovestruck's illustrations explore femme aesthetics, focused on lesbian and feminist subjects. Genevieve's work strives to deal with reclamation of space and challenges heteronormativity. Designed in Montreal.

title: Lumafina
description: Lumafina Jewelry is made by Portland, Oregon based jewelry designer Hilary Alexander. She strives to create jewelry that is eco-friendly, sometimes using vintage materials.

title: Luxurious Linens
description: Linen is the ultimate summer fabric! It's breathable, comfortable, and truly timeless. Below are a few of our dreamiest linen pieces on offer!

title: Machete
description:
The Machete jewelry label was established in 2017, designed by Jennifer J. Matchett. Machete jewelry is a line of eco-conscious, affordable jewelry for everyday wear. All materials used are Italian imported, high grade, cellulose acetates. Importantly, Machete jewelry is ecologically friendly and does not support unfair labor practices.

The acetate they source is high quality and non-petroleum based, imported from Italy. Cellulose acetate is a natural and renewable material, providing an eco-friendly alternative to a petroleum-based material.

Cellulose acetate is made by extracting cellulose fibres from cotton and wood pulp to create a transparent paste. This paste can then be coloured, processed, and molded for a variety of industrial applications. For this jewelry, it is cut from a large block into thin sheets and then cut again into smaller rectangular blocks.

Made in Atlanta, GA

title: Marigold
description: Founded by Quebec designer Marilyne Baril, Marigold is made locally in Montreal with respect for people and the environment equally.

title: Market Canvas
description: When you shop at Victoire you are supporting independent Canadian designers from across the country like Julie Neufeld. Julie created her first leather bag in 2010, inspired by the blank canvas and innovative female artists before her, Julie creates covetable, highly functional leather bags. As a self taught designer, Julie has honed her craft, bringing her concepts to life with utmost quality in mind. With an extensive understanding of both the materials she works with and the wardrobes her bags are destined to join, each piece is thoughtfully considered and designed with you, and people like you in mind. Each bag is handmade with love in Tofino, British Columbia.

title: Mary Young
description: Mary Young is a Toronto-based lingerie brand that makes comfortable and sexy undergarments.

title: Maximalist Gems
description: Bold, playful, and made to turn heads, Maximalist Gems is your go-to for statement pieces that sparkle with personality. Packed with colour, pattern, and trend-forward flair, this collection is for the style lovers who believe more is more!

title: Meemoza
description:
Founded by designer Emilie Rioux, Meemoza's ethos is to create clothing that is sustainable, ethical, well tailored and timeless. Using natural, plant-derived fabrics like bamboo and organic cotton, Meemoza creates contemporary women's clothing that is feminine, comfortable and good for our planet!

The local production of its knit fabric is done in a sustainably managed factory based in Canada. This facility prides itself with responsible water consumption and disposal of the chemicals used in the production process.

title: Meg
description: Megan Kinny is the designer and founder of Meg, an ethically made, women run independent clothing line designing pieces that fit into our everyday life in Manhattan, Brooklyn, Toronto and beyond. Through creative personal styling and tailoring of each look Meg's goal is to make every customer feel her best self and have fun in the process.

title: Meg Does Pottery
description: Meg creates out of her home studio in Winnipeg. She specializes in abstract colour stories, precious decorative items and original patterns. Her items are created through some traditional methods such as wheel throwing or hand sculpting.

title: Megan MacWhirter
description: Meghan MacWhirter is a ceramicist based out of Calgary. She graduated from the University of Lethbridge with a BFA in Studio Art, where she learned ceramics. Meghan is inspired by the '60s and '70s, the outdoors, farm sanctuaries, Dolly Parton and rainbows. All of what she makes is created in the home she shares with her fiancé and two cats.

title: Mercedes Morin
description: Mercedes Morin is a clothing brand for women made by women that blends spontaneity and finesse. The designer creates pieces that she is excited to wear herself inspired by Montreal's casual-cool vibe. Each and every piece of Mercedes Morin clothing is thought and sewn by the designer and her mother Violaine Morin in their Montreal studio.

title: Mercy House
description:
Established in 2016,  Karen Vaquilar boldly began cultivating Mercy House’s vision after gaining experience for several years in the fashion industry. 

Recognizing the damaging and wasteful practices currently used worldwide in the industry, she sought to create a sustainable and ethical streetwear brand that could drive positive change. 

Named after her mother Mercy, Mercy House is a sustainable streetwear brand, designed and handmade in the heart of Montreal’s Mile End District. Inspired by music, street culture, minimalist architecture and modern art.

title: Metatron
description: Metatron Press is a Montreal-based award-winning literary publisher that specializes in publishing contemporary books by debut authors. They focus on publishing edgy and provocative books that don’t necessarily fit into pre-existing literary canons or traditions, carving out new ones in the process.

title: Middle Sister Co.
description: Jill, the creator behind Middle Sister Co., is a local Ottawa-based maker and artisan who repurposes old fabrics into new handmade patchwork and quilted pieces to be loved for years to come.

title: Miiken
description: Miiken's Erin joyfully handmakes each piece with Japanese glass seed beads and 14k gold finishings. She started beading as a teenager to reclaim her Haudenosaunee culture that she was estranged from at the time. Erin is at her happiest with the feeling of the beads in her hands, and aims to weave good energy into each item while creating sustainably-made pieces that will bring wearers joy for years to come.

title: Milo & Dexter
description: Quebec brand Milo & Dexter makes timeless yet modern garments, always made in Canada.

title: Minimalist Staples
description: Elevated staples that fit seamlessly into any wardrobe! These pieces are easy to grab-and-go without a second thought, knowing full well that you'll feel effortlessly chic.

title: Minnow Bathers
description: Beloved for their high-waisted bottoms and stunningly unique prints, Toronto's Minnow Bathers is a Canadian-made swimwear company. Their bathing suits are made out of recycled spandex and the company donates a portion of each sale to various environmental and human rights causes each year.

title: Moon Studio
description: Moon Studio is a creative center for mystics, creatives, and sensitives looking to live an aligned life. They are for the conscious and the curious. They serve beauty, spirituality, the elements, and inspiration.

title: Mou
description: Mou is a line of contemporary jewelry handcrafted by multidisciplinary artist Moule in her Mile End studio in Montreal. Cast in sterling silver using the lost-wax technique, each piece explores the fluidity of material through organic forms and expressive textures with a human feel. After only a few initial courses, Mou continued to refine her craft as a self-taught jeweler, cultivating an instinctive and singular approach to making. Inspired by feminism and her illustration practice, she creates genderless pieces that move between wearable art and playful adornment.

title: Munea Wadud
description:
Munea Wadud is a queer, femme, person of colour who is also an Ottawa-based
visual artist and activist.

title: Naked & Famous
description: Best known for their denim, Naked & Famous uses premium Japanese fabrics and all of their products are cut, sewn and made in Canada.

title: Natalie Joy
description: Natalie Joy thoughtfully hand fabricates her jewelry line in her Portland studio using both unique and traditional metal working techniques. We love her designs for their fun geometric shapes and clean lines. She primarily works with brass and silver.

title: Neblina y Noche
description: Neblina y Noche's Magnolia crafts all of her jewelry by using original designs and lost wax casting in Lanark County, Ontario.

title: Necklaces
description: Victoire's jewelry is made by independent Canadian designers dedicated to creativity and the finest craftsmanship using ethical business practices. We are thrilled by our collection of fun, eclectic and classic necklaces, from classic gold chains to layer, beaded chokers, statement pendants, or vintage-inspired lockets.

title: Nepheliad Jewelry
description: Nepheliad is designed by Scarlett Toletino. Mainly working with sterling silver and 14k gold, she creates simple, modern jewelry with an understated elegance, complimenting any style. Her barely-there style still catches the light, creating its own effortless statement. Designed and made in Canada.

title: Nic Nac
description: Nicnac is an independent, Toronto-based studio. Asymmetry and imperfection guide the creation of these objects, complementing the wearer’s movement. They are intended to act not just as accessories but as an extension of the self. At its core, Nicnac intends to question and explore the role of the accessory in design and fashion, and the often gendered nature of it.

title: Noemiah
description: Noemiah is a Montreal designer who creates feminine, modern clothing with unique touches of embroidery and print. We love her whimsical designs and relaxed, flowing sizing.

title: Odeyalo
description: Marie-Eve Proulx is the brains behind Montreal's cult favourite Odeyalo. They believe in high-quality pieces made from luxuriously soft fabrics – the word “odeyalo” translates to “blanket” in Russian! We love the brand for their relaxed, athleisure-inspired clothing.

title: Office Wear
description: Want to look ~profesh~ at work but don't want to sacrifice your personal style? These Canadian-made wardrobe essentials bring boss vibes AND fashion savvy!

title: Olive Rose Studio
description: Olive Rose Studio is a small creative brand, consisting of unique and entirely handmade pieces. Each piece is made thoughtfully by founder and designer Olivia Mansveld and provides a precious moment of tactile playfulness in the everyday, drawing inspiration from tactility in handmade textiles, juxtaposed with the essential, utilitarian nature of clothing. Olive Rose Studio recycles ubiquitous yet sturdy and comforting materials such as denims, sweater knits, and cashmere, giving products quality and integrity.

title: Olivia Warren
description: Olivia Warren who is a Toronto based jeweler and artist. Olivia is a Victoire alumni (past employee and great friend of Victoire). We are so happy to be able to offer Olivia's jewelry in the shop now.

title: Onderbroeks
description: Onderbroeks is a luxury robe and loungewear brand that is proud to be female-founded, Canadian-made and responsibly produced in Kingston, Ontario. Her team focuses on creating unique, high-quality garments using Oeko-Tex® certified, ethical, and sustainable fabric.

title: Oneiro
description: Oneiro is the jewelry line crafted by Alissa Ramage out of her home in Saskatchewan. Her brand ethos is to create staple pieces of jewelry that become your favourite adornments and express your creativity, strength, and self worth.

title: Online Exclusives
description: We've teamed up with our best independent Canadian designers to bring you some online exclusives! From more colours to further reduced prices, these styles aren't available in store. You can choose to have them shipped directly to you, or select in-store pick-up at our Ottawa boutique if you'd like to try them on at the shop.

title: ORA-C
description: When you shop at Victoire you are supporting independent Canadian designers like Caroline Pham the creator and designer of ORA-C Jewelry. Carline meticulously fabricates every piece by hand in her Montreal studio as unique wearable sculptural works. Her pieces are delicate yet bold, featuring striking color compositions and textured metal work. While Caroline finds beauty in the imperfections of the handmade object, her work is grounded in the value of good craftsmanship. She takes inspiration from ancient techniques and artifacts of the past, but her self-taught and experimental approach to jewelry-making paired with her eye for expressive styling gives an edge to her work.

title: Osei Duro
description: Maryanne Mathias and Molly Keogh are designers from Canada and the United States respectively. Osei-Duro was founded in 2011 and the company is based in Vancouver and Accra. The line currently produces textiles and garments in Ghana, applying hand techniques to simple contemporary designs, by sewers and dyers who are paid well above minimum wage.

title: Outerwear
description: Whether you need a light jacket or toque, this selection of Canadian-made outerwear is sure to have what you're looking for, all weather conditions included!

title: Overalls & Jumpsuits
description: Over-all, these ethically made jumpsuits and overalls are as cool as they are comfy! Whether your are looking for a tailored dressier cut, a fun free flowing cut, or something in-between - you'll find your new perfect full-length jumpsuit here!

title: Palma
description: Montreal's Palma was founded by sisters Maud and Edith, who collaborate with Indian artisans to create unique, block-printed garments.

title: Pants!
description: Well-fitting pants can be hard to find. Our Canadian designers make the most thoughtful pants for real bodies living real lives!

title: Paperole
description: Montreal's Paperole makes beautiful stationary in collaboration with Canadian visual artists.

title: Par Ici
description: Alynne Lavigne is a jewelry designer out of Toronto, ON.  With her line Par Ici, she creates captivating jewelry that walks the line between simplicity and boldness and balances contemporary design with hints of the past.

title: Penny Lebo
description: Penny Lebo is a Toronto-based artist whose work reflects a layered and playful approach to design.

title: People I've Loved
description: People I've Loved is a printmaking workshop in Oakland, California. Their objects, cards and prints are meant to facilitate connection between people and help them have authentic conversations.

title: Playful Prints
description: Jazz up your wardrobe with something funky, something fun, something patterned!

title: Province Apothecary
description: Province Apothecary sources the highest quality organic ingredients from each Canadian Province, and hand blends these ingredients in small batches to create skincare that will nourish and balance your skin.

title: Rare Specimen
description: Rare Specimens are made in Hamilton, Ontario using raw rocks, minerals and gemstones. Everything is sourced by hand and no two pairs are alike. Each rock is hand chiseled and hammered to get a perfect specimen for your jewelry!

title: Really, Man?
description: Really, Man? is a one-woman Toronto-based company producing music and culture-inspired hand-printed clothing, pins, patches and day-to-day essentials.

title: ReesaBobeesa
description: Reesa the designer behind ReesaBobeesa is a jewelry desginer based out of Los Angeles . Reesa creates collections of silly little products with love from a dream world, all based on original illustrations.

title: Regine's Favourites
description: Victoire co-owner Regine loves pieces that are laid-back, easy cool! Fundamentally a "jeans & t-shirt" girl at heart, if it can be paired with white Converse sneakers and a great jacket, Regine is all in. Here are some of her favourites in the shop.

title: Rennie by Megan Rennie
description: When you shop at Victoire, you're supporting independent designers like Megan Rennie. Megan is a fashion designer based out of Toronto ON, who is a protégé of the Birds of North America team! Rennie by Rennie is 100% made ethically in Toronto with design, patternmaking, grading, cutting and sewing done in her studio just off via Italia in Toronto. Rennie is a slow fashion brand, and I take great pride in using high quality materials to make well made garments that will last a lifetime. Rennie produce small batches with a focus on quality over quantity, and in every new collection is exploring ways in which she can make the brand more environmentally friendly.

title: Rightful Owner
description: Rightful Owner is designer Rose McMahon's dream clothing line. Derived from the desire to create over the top, playful clothes for the young at heart, her clothing is inspired by how she used to dress up as a child. She aims to inject that frivolity and fearlessness into clothing that can be worn day to day and for special occasions.

title: Rings
description: Victoire's jewelry is made by independent Canadian designers dedicated to creativity and the finest craftsmanship using ethical and sustainable business practices. We are thrilled by our collection of fun, eclectic and classic rings, perfect for layering and creating your dream stack. From fine, heirloom-worthy pieces by Alexandre Bergeron to stackable classics by Little Gold, Lisbeth and Second Aura, you're sure to find your new favourite made-in-Canada ring here.

title: Rompers
description: Romper's to romp around in!

title: Rose Fibers
description: Rose Fibers is created by Katie Rose, who primarily works with linen to create handmade pieces with a focus on comfort and ease while upholding a minimal and clean aesthetic. Katie's natural ability has been honed through work with Sheila Wong’s Fashion Design Studio and a dedication to sustainable clothing.

title: Rowe
description: Rowe was created and founded by Dani Barlett with the intention to showcase soft organic shapes and detailed textures within wearable jewellery. All pieces are created in Dani's own studio out of Toronto, Canada. Rowe is the namesake of Dani’s mother Brenda and grandfather George. Through her pieces, Dani is able to honour and maintain her family's profound joy for making and creating.

title: Sainte-Cecile
description: Sainte-Cecile is a design collaboration between Victoire and our good friend Nadyne who you may better know as the mind behind Girl From Away! Always game for some tongue and cheek word play, we love her clever sense of humour.

title: Sale
description: The best Canadian designers, on sale! Our clothing does not go on sale often, so seize the day if a dress, top or bottom is calling your name. All orders ship from our boutique located in Ottawa, Canada.

title: Sale (Bottoms)
description: The best Canadian designers, on sale! Our clothing does not go on sale often, so seize the day if a dress, top or bottom is calling your name. All orders ship from our boutique located in Ottawa, Canada.

title: Sale (Tops)
description: The best Canadian designers, on sale! Our clothing does not go on sale often, so seize the day if a dress, top or bottom is calling your name. All orders ship from our boutique located in Ottawa, Canada.

title: Sama Rakk
description: Sama Rakk is led by two creative sisters working in the domains of visual arts, design and technology, who share a love for unique and funky earrings. They started experimenting with creating their own and realized how much they loved collaborating together as siblings. They named their brand SAMA RAKK as it means “sibling” in Wolof, the language spoken in Senegal, as they both share a Senegalese and French-Canadian heritage.

title: Samantha Pleet
description: Samantha Pleet designs otherworldly clothing that is both whimsical and wearable. Her garments are produced at a women owned factory in NYC as well as Fair trade factories in India and China depending on where her natural materials were sourced.

title: Sarah Mulder
description: Sarah Mulder jewelry is all handmade in Vancouver, B.C. using unique charms and stones to create the perfect finishing piece for your outfit.

title: Second Aura
description: Second Aura’s Courtney is an Indigenous goldsmith and beader based in Ottawa whose jewelry is made with thoughts of mixed heritage, ancestral knowledge, culture, land relationship and emotions.

title: Semi Fine Jewelry
description: Our semi-fine jewelry collection features pieces that are made using precious metals and techniques like coating. This collection has jewelry that is gold and silver plated, as well as gold filled, in addition to bronze items. These pieces are more affordable, great for everyday wear and, if treated well, can last for many years.

title: Shelter
description: Offering a focused line of essentials in linen, Shelter is a slow fashion brand inspired by the principles of beauty, quality, and sustainability. Each cut honours the architecture of the body, making space for women to move, play, and work. Each piece is designed on Vancouver Island by Alison McLean, the business mom hustler behind Shelter, and all of their clothing is hand-made by a small team of kick-ass ladies in their small studio in Courtenay, British Columbia.

title: Shimmer Holiday Dress Flash Sale
description: Get ready for the party in style by taking 20% off this collection of holiday styles with the promo code SHIMMER at check out from Dec. 15-18 only!

title: Shorts
description: A collection of Canadian designed and made shorts! Whether you like em' short, long, flowy or fitted, we have them all here in one spot!

title: Simple Chains
description: Victoire's jewelry is made by independent Canadian designers dedicated to creativity and the finest craftsmanship using ethical business practices. We are thrilled by our collection of fun, eclectic and classic chains, perfect for layering.

title: Sisaret
description: Sisaret is a line of small-batch jewelry and ceramics founded by two sisters with Finnish roots.

title: Skirts
description: A collection of Canadian designed and made skirts for you to dance and twirl around in!

title: Smoking Lily
description: Smoking Lily is located in Victoria, BC where all of their creations are designed, sewn and silk-screened in-house by a small handful of talented people. Smoking Lily's mission is to make comfortable, stylish, quality, affordable goods that are kind to the earth using mostly OEKO-TEX® certified fabrics and non-toxic inks in their print room.

title: Socks
description: A collection of socks done by independent designers to delight your footsies

title: Soleé Darrell
description: Soleé Darrell is a Bermudian born artist based in California. Her work is purely intuition-driven.

title: Sophie Kissin Jewelry
description: A native of Saint Paul, Minnesota, Sophie creates a mix of delicate and bold pieces inspired by art, art history and nature. She recently relocated her home and studio to Albuquerque, New Mexico and thinks that special pieces make life just a little bit sweeter.

title: Spotlight on BIPOC Designers
description: Since June 2020, Victoire has committed to growing the representation of BIPOC-owned brands to 20% of the store, a target we’ve met and look forward to continually exceeding. We strive to reflect the full spectrum of the design community of Canada and are especially dedicated to increasing the representation of Indigenous designers.

title: Spring 2024 Capsule Wardrobe
description: Looking to start a capsule wardrobe? Here's all the essentials for creating one for Spring 2024!

title: Stationery
description: All your stationary needs in one place - find notebooks, greeting cards, calendars, and stickers here!

title: Stefanie Sheehan
description: Stefanie Sheehan makes her jewelry at her home studio in Long Island, NY.

title: Stocking Stuffers
description: An assortment of small gift items perfect to add as stocking stuffers!

title: Studs
description: Victoire's jewelry is made by independent Canadian and American designers dedicated to creativity and the finest craftsmanship using ethical business practices. We are thrilled by our collection of fun, eclectic and classic stud earrings.

title: Sundara Mar
description: Sundara Mar is a sustainable jewelry line created by Houston based designer Vanessa Martinez. She uses cellulose acetate, a renewable material made from cotton and wood pulp, to create her modern, timeless styles.

title: Sunday Feel
description: Mangie Chan is an artist of many mediums; silversmith, photographer, visual designer and all around dreamer. She is inspired by memories of childhood, of growing up, & pop culture, and her designs often evoke a sense of sentimentality and connection. The result is a mix of dreamy designs that cultivate a sense of dualities: high/low, weird/cute, hard/soft.

title: Sunday Skies
description: Sunday Skies Studio is a female-owned business run by two besties from Ottawa. After 15 years of friendship and a pandemic, they finally decided to launch their own brand together! They've designed each aspect of their business, down to their colour formulas, to reflect fun and positivity, a feeling they hope to bring to your favourite space.

title: Super Sensitive
description: Super Sensitive's Daria Joyce makes tees, decals and art prints for anyone who believes their emotions and sensitivity are their superpower!

title: Sweet 16 Sale
description: We're celebrating our 16th business birthday by giving you a present! From Thursday, November 10 to Sunday, November 13, take 20% off this collection with discount code SWEET16.

title: Sweet Juju
description: Julia Surich, the designer and creator behind Sweet Juju. Julia is based out of Toronto, Ontario where they focus on lovingly handmade clothing from vintage and sustainable fabrics that can be described as classic, with a touch of whimsy!

title: Swim
description: Stay fresh at the beach, lake or pool with a sustainable and eco-friendly bathing suit.

title: Take Me Out
description: Let's all go out tonight, we've got lots of things for us each to wear

title: Talee
description: Lorraine Lee is the founder and designer of TALEE, a line of handmade textile earrings. She began creating her collection through a love for boating and knot tying she learned from her father at a very young age. Lee is currently based in Calgary, Canada.

title: Tanks
description: Show off your arms with these ethically made sleeveless tops and tanks!

title: Taylor Made
description: Anna Taylor is a multidisciplinary craft artist based in Halifax.

title: Teenadult
description: Teenadult's Kezna Dalz is a Montreal-based multidisciplinary artist. Her work is recognizable by its raw features and bright colors with recurring themes of feminism, the fight against racism, popular culture and sexuality. Although she tackles sometimes difficult subjects, her art makes them accessible with the help of a pastel and soft universe with naive features.

title: The Vintage Royalty
description: The Vintage Royalty's Meena Osei-Kuffour started the brand in 2009. Girl Scouts was a major influence on her childhood, as a place where she could dream, explore, and create without limitations. Meena believes this group is the one who taught her about friendship, running a business, reaching attainable goals, and using her imagination, all skills she's used to run The Vintage Royalty for the past twelve years!

title: Thief & Bandit
description: Thief and Bandit is a line of hand printed, hand made apparel out of Halifax, Nova Scotia founded by Amie Cunningham. They use quality organic fabric with unique hand drawn prints created by Cunningham, that they then sew into garments that are both easy and fun to wear! All of their fabric is hand printed in house using giant silkscreens on organic jersey fabric. Thief & Bandit is fashion with consciousness, truly and proudly handmade.

title: Tiana Beads
description: Tiana Vincent is a Huron-Wendat beadworker based on unceded Algonquin-Anishinabeg lands. We also have the pleasure of working with her at our shop in Ottawa where she is a dynamic & incredibly sweet member of our team.

title: Tiro Tiro
description: Informed by traditional craft practices and almost 20 years of jewelry-making experience, Teresa Robinson of Tiro Tiro designs enduring, covetable pieces for everyday use and enjoyment. Their jewelry is made in Portland, Oregon.

title: Toast & Yarn
description: Toast & Yarn's Becky Gravenor knits every piece by hand in her Toronto studio.

title: Toni Darling Frank
description: Toni Darling Frank makes all of her ceramics by hand in Toronto, Ontario.

title: Tops
description:
Victoire curates a collection of Canada designed and made tops, sweaters, blouses, t-shirts and turtlenecks that combines joyful style, sustainable and ethical manufacturing, and a goal of being the vintage of tomorrow.

For over fifteen years, the majority of women's clothing and accessories we showcase in our Ottawa boutique are proudly and ethically made in Canada. We are slow fashion at our core.


We don’t believe in any fashion rules other than joyously dressing for yourself.

title: Travel Edit!
description: Have a trip coming up and not sure what to pack? Check out this curated selection of pieces made from lightweight and breathable fabrics that would be great to travel with and wear on your next vacation! Easy to pack, and easy to wear to stun in the sun ;)

title: True Middle
description: True Middle is a Toronto-based jewelry line by Emma Robinson. True Middle has evolved into a jewelry brand, with each piece the product of every favourite song, late night walk, childhood memory and perfect thrift find that inspired Emma.

title: Tshirts
description: Nothing beats jeans and a graphic tee for an instant cool look! This selection of unisex tees feature fun illustrations, slogans and prints created by independent designers.

title: Uni Design
description: When you shop at Victoire you are supporting independent Canadian designers from across the country like Maya Bergeron-Robitaille, the founder and designer behind Uni Design. Uni Design is a slow fashion brand based in Vancouver, B.C., driven by a passion for sustainable fashion and creative expression. Uni Design's journey began with a vision to transform fashion into a force for good. Specializing in crafting clothing for all genders, creating one-of-a-kind patchwork pieces from upcycled textiles and scraps.

title: Ursa Minor
description: Ursa Minor Clothing is made by Elizabeth Hudson, who makes each piece by hand in her Montreal studio. She uses natural fabrics to create timeless pieces that feel as beautiful as they look. Her Flor Arca pants have become an instant classic, and no capsule wardrobe is complete without these incredible pants.

title: Valerie C
description: Valerie Canuel is the designer and founder of Valerie C. Designs. Valerie has spent more than 10 years in the fashion industry between Montreal, Quebec and Paris, France; and is a graduate of Fashion Design and Marketing. Valerie's brand is a showcase of her values and passion for slow fashion with an emphasis on a contribution to build a more informed and transparent fashion industry.

title: Valerie Dumaine
description:
Valérie Dumaine (1977–2025) was a key figure in Canadian and Quebec fashion. The Montreal-born designer was known for her minimalist, structured style, as well as for her ethical and sustainable approach. An ardent advocate of “slow fashion” since starting her line in 2003, she made it her mission to create timeless collections made entirely in Canada from materials that were both durable and comfortable. Her career spanned more than 20 years, and her designs have been sold across the country, as well as in the United States and Japan. If you are looking for a classic little black dress, the perfect work wardrobe piece or a cozy sweater with interesting detailing, look no further.

Proceeds from these already-discounted items will be donated to the Fonds Valérie Dumaine (in Memoriam), which aims to support cancer research as well as the provision of palliative and end-of-life care focused on compassion and dignity.

title: Valerie Dumaine Blow-Out Sale!
description: Take 50-70% off ALL pieces by Valerie Dumaine, no discount code needed! Quantities are extremely limited with only 1-2 sizes left per style, so if there's something that catches your eye, don't hesitate.

title: Vanderzee
description: Kristin is the designer behind Ottawa-based Vanderzee. She's a self-taught metalsmith who makes handcrafted heirloom quality pieces by hand.

title: Vardi
description: Vardì, which translates to "my flower", is an Ottawa-based brand of jewelry with designs that are modern and innovative. Each piece is handcrafted from metals and semiprecious stones to create a timeless piece of jewelry.

title: Vera Vero
description:
Victoire carried this line, formerly known as Nokomis (named after one of the founders grandmother's), over 6 years ago and it was a sad day when they closed their doors in Edmonton, Alberta . Owned by two friends, Elizabeth Hudson, who you know from Ursa Minor, and Jessica Kennedy, they each took time for their own individual projects but have gotten back together to bring you ten classic designs updated for the modern woman. Featuring beautiful fabrics and flattering cuts, their pieces are the epitome of smart and beautiful design.

As always, they remain committed to sustainable, local production. All their pieces are designed, drafted & cut by hand, and produced in limited quantity by a small team in Montreal, Canada.

title: Veri
description: Veri is a line of seasonless gender-neutral clothing made in Montreal.

title: Victoire19
description: For 19 years we have relied on excellent designers, a dedicated team, and loyal customers who evangelize for buying better, buying Canadian, buying Victoire! We want to thank you all with the ultimate loot bag: 19% off  from now until Sunday June 1st. Discount automatically applies on the Birthday Collection at checkout.

title: Villarreal Ceramics
description: Vanessa Villarreal the maker and creator of Villarreal Ceramics. Vanessa creates both small sculptural work and decorative functional pots for the home. Vanessa explores and play with different themes on nostalgia, folk art, folk tales, childhood dreams, feminism & mysticism. Each ceramic piece is handmade in her home studio in Hull, Quebec, Canada.

title: Vintage Inspired
description:
Romantic, soft, timeless, and effortlessly feminine The Vintage Inspired Collection brings classic styles to modern life. A romantic curation of feminine soft silhouettes, nostalgic and delicate details, and effortless charm. Perfect for slow mornings, golden hours, and everything in between.

This collection carries everything from delicate blouses and high-waisted skirts to dreamy floral prints and flowy dresses, this collection celebrates a slower, more graceful era of fashion

title: Vintage Victoire
description:
We've always said that the clothes we sell are the "vintage of tomorrow," so it's exciting for us to finally close the loop in our consumption cycle and offer Vintage Victoire pieces at amazing prices. 

We have always stood by the superior quality manufacturing of the made-in-Canada clothing we carry, often with a focus on zero waste processes, natural materials, slow batch production, and a whole lot of heart. All pieces in our Vintage Victoire collection are in excellent second hand condition.

All sales from the Vintage Victoire collection are FINAL SALE.

title: Vintagetears Jewellery
description: Anyssa is the owner of Vintagetears Jewellery Design. Based in Ottawa, Ontario, they make minimalist styles perfect to wear everyday!

title: Waves of Hydra
description: Waves of Hydra is designed by Lindsay Ferlund. Lindsay started working as a clothing cutter for indie brands in Toronto before co-founding beloved Canadian jean company Iris Denim. In 2019, Lindsay started Waves of Hydra to explore more avenues of fashion and create her own highly wearable dream wardrobe.

title: Wawa Designs
description: Wawa Designs is hand printed by Sarah Creskey in Toronto.

title: We are Stories
description: We Are Stories is designed, cut and sew out of designer Tracy Fillion’s home studio near Nelson BC. Using natural and eco sourced materials and creating the pieces in small batches, Tracy’s goal is to provide consumers with ethical and environmentally conscious alternatives.

title: Wedding Season
description: Whether you're the one getting married, a member of the bridal party or simply a guest, here are our picks to look your best for wedding season!

title: White Elephant
description: White Elephant was a boutique run by our two pals in Hamilton, Ontario.

title: Winona Irene
description: Unique home goods and accessories designed in Los Angeles by Winona Irene herself.

title: With Nini
description: With Nini is the creation of Nini Noun; a Cambodian-Canadian designer whose whimsical designs are produced with sustainability in mind. Her pieces are lovingly made in Ottawa, Ontario from upcycled materials.

title: Wkndrs
description: WKNDRS is a Vancouver-based pin, patch and accessory line.

title: Wyatt House Design
description: Wyatt House Design is an Ottawa-based brand that's a part of the zero waste fashion movement by making one-of-a-kind clothing using second-hand textiles.

title: YUUN
description: Lina Hu makes every piece of YUUN jewellery thoughtfully and sustainably in Montreal. YUUN is expressive jewelry for the discerning and contemporary. Intentionally designed, each collection is an intuitive and almost philosophical exploration of form and element. Bold but with confident restraint and often subtly playful, YUUN is made for the wearer to instill their own sensibility.

title: Zaleska
description: Sylvia Tennant is the designer behind Zaleska Jewelry. The brand is handmade by Sylvia and her talented team of silversmiths in Vancouver, B.C. and Bali, Indonesia.

title: Zenny Jane
description: Toronto's Emilie Gauvreau is the brains behind Zenny Jane. The brand specializes in fine jewelry with a nostalgic vibe, made with real gold, quality materials and tons of love!
